title: Parshotam Lal Dhingra v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Parshotam Lal Dhingra v. Union of India, 1958 SCR 828
content.holding: The Doctrine of Pleasure in Article 310 is qualified by Article 311; Article 311 protects against dismissal, removal, and reduction in rank when visited with punishment or stigma.
content.relevance: Foundational ruling on scope of Article 311 protection.
